reply.text:
Sorry to hear that, and no streak is worth training sick. Getting through the flu is the harder part, and you did. Good to have you back. We start from today.

Ease in rather than trying to make up for lost time. One normal session this week, keeping the weights a notch lighter than where you left off, will get your body moving again. Then build back to your usual schedule over the next week or two. If you're still feeling wiped out or something feels off, check with your doctor before pushing the pace.

Want me to set up today's session, or look at where your program stands so we can pick the right place to jump back in?
